sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description:
The name of the filter key. Valid values:
- AccessGroup (not supported for agentic)
- AccessPointId
- AgenticSpaceId

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the filter key.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of results to return per query.

- Maximum value: 100.
- Minimum value: 10.
- Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The query token. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken that was returned in the previous API call.
